access: authenticated users admitted by the existing runtime policy

/v1/kahroba/current-room.authorization: authenticated membership; latest nonclosed Kahroba room only; no invitation secret

/v1/kahroba/lobby-permissions.authorization: any currently admitted user may create a room

/v1/kahroba/rooms/{id}/start.authorization: host + bound private match + all durable readyAt + expectedVersion + actionId

/v1/kahroba/matchmaking/current.authorization: authenticated actor's own unexpired search or active matched seat only

/v1/kahroba/matches/{id}/lobby.authorization: admitted match member; pregame human seat; active replaced seats recover spectator table; Kahroba MATCHMAKING only; no hidden state

/v1/kahroba/matches/{id}/start.authorization: persisted host; expectedVersion/actionId; cancellation restricted to pregame

/v1/kahroba/matches/{id}/cancel.authorization: persisted host; expectedVersion/actionId; cancellation restricted to pregame

/v1/kahroba/rooms/{id}/cancel.authorization: room host + bound waiting match; expectedVersion/actionId; closes room after commit

policy.prepare: host room:start freezes full roster into WAITING_FOR_PLAYERS
policy.ready: match:ready persists readiness in WAITING_FOR_PLAYERS; canStart requires every durable readyAt
policy.start: explicit authenticated host start; recovery completes STARTING
policy.rollback: fully ready new rooms remain WAITING_FOR_PLAYERS and retained APIs hold them; preserve readyAt and compatible v2 Worker; no DB rewind
policy.host: private room host; public match seat zero
policy.queueRecovery: one bounded own-partition tick per successful authenticated search/status; durable status re-enqueues after Redis recovery
